note: Participant-made evaluation cases. Expectations were derived by hand from participant-facing evidence, not from engine output.

cases.title: Request email in upper case (case_09 subject)

request.request_text: Please permanently delete the account associated with this email address.

cases.why: Email matching must be case-insensitive; the answer must equal sample case_09 (backup_4978 restorable in evidence_93).

cases.title: Historical email after an email change (user_11)

request.request_text: I would like the account associated with this address to be erased.

cases.why: audit_277 changed user_11's email on 2026-05-17; the account admin screenshot evidence_04 (2026-09-26) still shows account_5762 with name, email and phone.

cases.title: Non-deletion request in Spanish

request.request_text: Por favor actualicen mi dirección de envío. No borren mi cuenta ni mis pedidos, sigo comprando en la tienda.

cases.why: The person asks for an address update and explicitly says not to delete anything.

cases.title: Audit before the deletion: no evidence from the future

request.request_text: Je demande la suppression définitive du compte associé à cette adresse e-mail.

cases.why: Same subject as sample case_03, audited a day before the 2026-09-15 deletion run. evidence_94 (2026-09-26) proves case_03's answer but must not be used here.

cases.title: Look-alike decoy in the same search result

request.request_text: Please close my account and process the associated personal-data deletion.

cases.why: The search console screenshot evidence_09 (2026-09-01) shows search_428 for g.silva76@gmail.com (user_13) and search_1874 for g.silva76.jr@gmail.com, a different person.
